summary: Comprehensive testing of Nua AI Assistant Iteration 4 completed. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend features working correctly. New 7 Intelligence Layers tested: Layer 2 (Memory OS with 6 types), Layer 3 (Trust Engine with score calculation), Layer 4 (Autonomous Action Engine T0-T5), Layer 5 (Goals with sub-tasks and AI analysis), Layer 6 (Dreams 2.0 with cross-referenced insights), Layer 7 (Enhanced system prompt with memory-aware chat).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: Memory OS (Layer 2) - 6 intelligence types (identity, episodic, semantic, behavioral, emotional, relationship) working perfectly
Backend: Memory OS - Advanced memory creation with confidence, why, use_count, last_used fields working correctly
Backend: Memory OS - Explain endpoint returns detailed explanation (why, source, confidence, first_learned, last_used, times_used)
Backend: Memory OS - Forget endpoint deletes memory and logs to trust ledger (correction event with -1 score)
Backend: Trust Engine (Layer 3) - Trust score calculation from ledger events working correctly
Backend: Trust Engine - Score ranges 0-100 with levels (New, Learning, Building Trust, Trusted, Highly Trusted, Autonomous)
Backend: Trust Engine - Breakdown by event types (success, failure, correction, rejection, confirmation, prediction)
Backend: Trust Engine - Trust ledger stores all events with score_change and timestamps
Backend: Autonomous Action Engine (Layer 4) - T0-T5 tier definitions working correctly
Backend: Action tiers - T0-T2 are auto-execute, T3-T5 require approval
Backend: Action log tracks all actions with tier, intent, result, risk_level, verified status
Backend: Goals (Layer 5) - Create, list, add sub-tasks, toggle completion working perfectly
Backend: Goals - Progress calculation based on completed sub-tasks (50% for 1/2, 100% for 2/2)
Backend: Goals - Status changes to 'completed' when progress reaches 100%
Backend: Goals - AI analysis using GPT-5.2 generates actionable insights (tested successfully)
Backend: Dreams (Layer 6) - List dreams with 10 categories (opportunity, pattern, reminder, concern, optimization, relationship, finance, productivity, learning, business)
Backend: Dreams - Generate dream using GPT-5.2 cross-references all user data (memories, conversations, goals, expenses, reminders, trust score, recent messages)
Backend: Dreams - Dream structure includes category, title, content, impact (low/medium/high), acted_on, source_data
Backend: Enhanced Chat (Layer 7) - Memory-aware system prompt includes all 7 intelligence layers
Backend: Enhanced system prompt - Includes trust context, memory classification guidance, goal awareness
Backend: Enhanced action processing - Supports goal creation via action blocks, logs to trust ledger
Frontend: Dashboard - Trust Score widget showing percentage (66%), level (Trusted), and event count (10 events tracked)
Frontend: Dashboard - Latest NUA Dream widget showing dream title and content preview
Frontend: Memory screen - 6 type chips with counts (Identity: 2, Episodic: 0, Semantic: 0, Behavioral: 2, Emotional: 0, Relationship: 0)
Frontend: Memory screen - Type chip filtering working (click to filter by type)
Frontend: Memory screen - Each memory card shows type icon, key, value, confidence percentage
Frontend: Memory screen - Explain button (?) for each memory to show why NUA remembers it
Frontend: Memory screen - Forget button (trash icon) for each memory with trust logging
Frontend: Memory screen - Add memory form with type selection, key, value inputs
Frontend: Life Hub - Goals tab with 'New Goal' button, goal cards with progress bars
Frontend: Life Hub - Goals - Sub-task list with checkboxes, 'Add sub-task' button
Frontend: Life Hub - Goals - Analyze button (bulb icon) for AI-powered goal analysis
Frontend: Life Hub - Dreams tab with 'Generate New Dream' button (purple/gold styling)
Frontend: Life Hub - Dreams - Dream cards with category badges, impact labels, content
Frontend: Life Hub - All 5 tabs working (Goals, Dreams, Reminders, Notes, Expenses)
Frontend: All 4 main tabs working correctly (Nua, Dashboard, Memory, Life Hub)
All interactive elements have proper testID attributes for testing
MongoDB ObjectId properly excluded in all queries
Environment variables correctly used throughout
React Native components properly used (no HTML elements)
GPT-5.2 integration working for goal analysis and dream generation (real AI, not mocked)
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create and clean up test data properly. Test memories, goals, and dreams are created with TEST_ prefix for easy identification. Cleanup fixture removes test memories and goals after tests complete. Trust ledger events and dreams are permanent by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 complete and fully functional. All 7 intelligence layers working correctly. Memory OS has 6 types with advanced features (confidence, why, explain, forget). Trust Engine calculates score from ledger events with 6 levels. Autonomous Action Engine has T0-T5 tiers. Goals support sub-tasks, progress tracking, and AI analysis. Dreams 2.0 cross-references all user data to generate insights. Enhanced system prompt integrates all layers. Frontend properly displays all new features. Public URL: https://jarvis-beta.preview.emergentagent.com. All tests passing.
